title: शरदधा धारे शरदधा धारे, सुन ज्ञान कथा तु, शरदधा धारे
romanTitle: Shraddhaa Dhaare Shraddhaa Dhaare, Sun Jnyaan Kathaa Tu, Shraddhaa Dhaare
firstLine: Shraddhaa Dhaare Shraddhaa Dhaare, Sun Jnyaan Kathaa Tu, Shraddhaa Dhaare. Sant Janon Ke Jaay Dvaare (Tek).
